acceptanceCriteria: `corvint dogfood status` (or a new read-only verb) emits a handoff receipt: session key, root, bound revision, task anchors, packet sha256 and bytes, and the degradation list; the receipt is data under the untrusted envelope and grants no authority.

A second session on the same revision consuming the receipt re-resolves the same packet sha256, and on a different revision reports the exact drift (revision and anchors) instead of silently recompiling; both cases have unit or integration vectors.
session-context-dividend-v0.md records which requirements this slice delivers and which stay deferred; docs/DOGFOOD.md documents the handoff step.
body: Filed 2026-09-23 from the owner's review of JetBrains Air (jetbrains.com/air, JetBrains blog 2026-09-22): the owner accepted the idea for 1.0. Air is a cloud/IDE orchestration platform; only its contracts transfer. Invariant 7 (AGENTS.md) still holds: no hosted service, UI, daemon or network dependency on the local path. Air moves work between developers and agents while maintaining context. Corvint's enrollment already survives a handoff (a handed-off enrollment keeps its original key and root), but the receiving session has no compact receipt naming the packet digest, bound revision and task anchors it should re-resolve, so context is re-derived and may differ. docs/specs/session-context-dividend-v0.md (deferred) covers exact-key local reuse; this ticket takes only the handoff-receipt slice and leaves the rest deferred.

completion.reason: Completed 2026-09-24 by PR #127 (merge d1a82e554). Criterion 1: the new read-only subverb corvint dogfood handoff emits a receipt with session key, root, bound revision, enrollment and task anchors, packet sha256 and bytes, degradations and authority none inside the untrusted envelope (SESSION-V0-017/018, docs/specs/session-context-dividend-v0.md:170-197). Criterion 2: --receipt re-resolves the same packet sha256 or exits 1 with an exact drift list, withholding the recompiled packet (SESSION-V0-019, :198); TestDogfoodHandoffReceiptReresolvesSamePacket and TestDogfoodHandoffReportsRevisionAndAnchorDrift (cmd/corvint/dogfood_handoff_test.go:114, :182) pass at 6d4873a. Only a second call on the same machine and clone was tested; re-resolution on a second host is inferred, not observed. Criterion 3: the spec records delivery partial, with SESSION-V0-017..019 delivered and 001..016 deferred (:6, :13, :29-35, :308-311); docs/DOGFOOD.md:517-522 documents the handoff step. Owner-only: the spec intent and the CCF-V1-002 amendment are proposed; the use-case receipt repin restates attested digests (follow-up V1-0216). Sealed at .corvint/changes/3c2a465d630da31f6f4210fba56bc0837d8d35ca.cem.json. Evidence digests: sha256 at 6d4873a of the sealed CEM, dogfood_handoff.go, dogfood_handoff_test.go, session-context-dividend-v0.md, DOGFOOD.md. NOT_RUN: make gate (owner focused-verification policy).

title: dogfood: emit a handoff receipt (packet digest, revision, task anchors) that a second session or host re-resolves exactly
